homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. No card is a homonym, and T composes no other entity under the name; the capture's reached kind is 'same' (per_dim.reached). 'Digital Dada Library', 'International Online Bibliography of Dada' and dada.lib.uiowa.edu are the census's other names and host for the entity; 'Digital Dada Archive' is International Times' title for the Digital Dada Library; www.lib.uiowa.edu/dada/ is the Libraries' gateway page for it. The distinct entities below are named by the field, the census or the archive beside the entity and are never senses of its name.
distinct_entities: the University of Iowa Libraries, the holder (F26, LS-03), an institution distinct from the Archive; its Special Collections Department, Main Library and Art Library, where the holdings sit

Dada/Surrealism, the journal the Archive publishes (F41), and the Association for the Study of Dada and Surrealism, its sponsor: a journal and a society, distinct from the Archive ('NOT a surrealism archive', LS-32)
Dada, the movement (Zurich, 1916; Wikipedia's article, B7), the Archive's object, distinct from the Archive
the Dada Archive and Research Center, of which an earlier front page made the Archive a part (F18): a body unread here, distinct
Timothy Shipe, the curator (F31, F13), a person
the People's Graphic Design Archive (B2), International Times (B4) and Open Culture (F21), resources that list or describe the Archive

the archive's own seat of Dada originals, the Originals Library seat 18/04 (#1682, traininglayerliterature.org/originals/dada/), seated from other witnesses: a distinct holding, which names no Iowa source

the dadaists named in the list (Clément Pansaers, Julius Krekel; Salomo Friedlaender, Mynona; Iliazd, Ilia Zdanevich; Edgar Firn, Karl Döhman, Daimonides; Jean or Hans Arp): persons and names of persons, whose relation the list records and does not decide (LS-14)
Neighbours in the census (rows built the same day under the same brief): Arquivo Pessoa, Pessoa Digital, UbuWeb, Eclipse, Jacket2, PennSound, the Electronic Poetry Center, distinct aggregators

captures.description: THE ARCHIVE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The International Dada Archive is a premier scholarly research center for the historic Dada movement, housed at the University of Iowa Libraries in Iowa City, Iowa.' Overview and history (founded 1979 'following a 1978 international Dada conference'; location; scope as 'One of the world's largest repositories'); collection and resources (the Online Bibliography of roughly 60,000 titles, the Digital Dada Library, formats, Dada/Surrealism); an offer to guide the user. Four cards: the University of Iowa Libraries, People’s Graphic Design Archive, The Gazette, International Times.

atoms.evidence: International Dada Archive - University of Iowa Libraries
housed at the University of Iowa Libraries in Iowa City, Iowa.
Established in 1979 following a 1978 international Dada conference hosted at the university.
is a premier scholarly research center for the historic Dada movement
The archive's primary catalog containing roughly 60,000 titles of books, articles, and resources by and about Dadaists.
